items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in physics or closely related field preferred.
Prior work experience in an optics laboratory setting required.
Contribute to student-facing course materials: draft handouts, test instrument operating procedures, set up and maintain the teaching laboratory as needed.
Active support for the College’s Principles of Community and Institutional Values in the performance of job duties.
Working familiarity with optical components from Thorlabs required.
Prior experience with Thorlabs Quantum Optics Educational Kit (QOP1) preferred.
Ability to demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, and meticulous attention to detail.
Ability to interact professionally with a diverse clientele of faculty, staff, and other members of a college community.
Proficiency in PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and other standard issue Windows software, and willingness and ability to learn others as necessary.
Demonstrated proficiency in LABVIEW preferred but not required.
